text:
Marta Ivanov: hey all, quick question — I'm in week 1 and merged my onboarding kubeconfig into ~/.kube/config, but my app in VSCode keeps hitting my minikube cluster. Kubectl in terminal uses the right context though. Any ideas?

Marta Ivanov: terminal: `kubectl config current-context` -> onb-marta@dev. VSCode: azure-k8s extension shows minikube.

DevEx Bot: welcome Marta! :wave: VSCode extensions sometimes read a different KUBECONFIG or cache contexts. Quick things to check:
• open a terminal inside VSCode and run `echo $KUBECONFIG` and `kubectl config current-context` there
• check VSCode settings (workspace) for `kubeconfig` path or extension-specific setting
• restart the Kubernetes extension after changing config

Marta Ivanov: inside VSCode terminal `echo $KUBECONFIG` is empty and `kubectl current-context` shows onb-marta@dev. Extension still shows minikube.

Diego R.: had this — the extension may read the file from the OS keychain or an absolute path set in settings.json. In Command Palette run "Kubernetes: Set Kubeconfig" and point it at ~/.kube/config. Also check your workspace .vscode/settings.json for a hardcoded path like ~/kube/config-minikube.

Marta Ivanov: found it — workspace had "kubernetes.kubeconfig": "~/.kube/minikube-config" leftover from a sample repo. Changed to `~/.kube/config` and reloaded window. Extension now shows onb-marta@dev. Thanks!

Marta Ivanov: one more: after switching, `kubectl get pods -n onb-marta` returns `forbidden`. I can see my OIDC user in the kubeconfig. How do I get namespace access?

SRE Oncall: hey Marta — most onboarding namespaces are bound to group eng-onboarding. Can you paste `kubectl config view --minify --raw | grep -E "user:|name:" -A2` (redact tokens)? I'll check and create a short RoleBinding if needed.

Marta Ivanov: pasted (sanitized):
users:
- name: marta.ivanov@company (auth-provider: oidc)
contexts:
- name: onb-marta@dev
  context:
    cluster: dev-cluster
    namespace: onb-marta
    user: marta.ivanov@company

SRE Oncall: thanks — you aren't in eng-onboarding yet. Creating a 48h RoleBinding for user:marta.ivanov@company -> Role:onboard-reader in namespace onb-marta. Try again in a minute.

Marta Ivanov: works now, can list pods. Quick note for docs: VSCode workspace settings are a sneaky source of wrong kubeconfig. Might add that to DevEx.

DevEx Bot: great catch — added a small onboarding tip about checking editor/workspace kubeconfig overrides. Welcome aboard Marta! :tada:
